reloadFormula.curveSource: W46 cached oracle_engine weapon_formulas.json, verified against stat_calc.rs and rs_types.rs
reloadFormula.bowBoundary: No selected Outlaw bow. Do not confuse effective stat cap100 with Oracle bow curve clamp85 or its special scalar formula.
reloadFormula.precision: Evaluate unrounded seconds at modified stat, apply0.9, ceil once. Multiplying old integer ticks by0.9 ignores +70 and is invalid.
reloadFormula.currentness: This is the current W62 contract using pinned historical W46 approximations, not a current live Destiny sandbox certification.

shellResearch.author: VanHolden304
shellResearch.classification: Community tester's historical first-hand account, 2020; not Bungie
shellResearch.finding: The tester times repeat insertions with the quadratic and reports a longer initial insertion without exact initial measurements. Their pre-November2020 Outlaw stat values are not used.
shellResearch.runtimePolicy: firstTicks equals intervalTicks to preserve existing WeaponReloadPolicy fallback. Both selected shotguns use9ticks; only the repeat interval is supported by the curve model.

animationSnapshot.policy: Snapshot phase durations at reload start. Each new timed reload can use Outlaw while the buff is active; an already-started phase keeps its captured deadline.
animationSnapshot.boundary: Authored integration policy. Retrieved sources do not establish mid-animation expiration, activation during reload, or per-shell re-evaluation; do not infer these from the six-second buff duration.

mixedPelletPrecision.boundary: Pool proves non-slug eligibility, not whether a mixed body/precision pellet volley counts as a precision kill. Use the runtime's actual critical final-blow transaction; that classification is a project policy until independently verified.

refreshAndConsumption.policy: A fresh qualifying precision final blow resets the deadline to now+120. Reloads neither consume the buff nor extend it; stow clears it.
refreshAndConsumption.boundary: Repeated-kill refresh and non-consumption are integration choices consistent with a timed precision-kill buff, not separately measured here.

limitations: No live gameplay tests or exhaustive later-patch audit.
Pool availability is optional-roll eligibility, not automatic equipment.
No enhanced, catalyst, same-name reissue, exotic or sword inferred.
No armor, magazine, masterwork, other perks, frame-specific extra scalar or empty-mag modifier simulated.
No verified exact first-shell delay, animation snapshot, tick endpoint or mixed-pellet classification.
